title: Data Centers Use Old Jet Engines Amid Power Grid Delays
excerpt: Data center builders are turning to discarded jet engines to generate power as they face lengthy waits for grid access and new turbines.
body_html:
Data center developers are adopting an unusual alternative to meet their energy needs as waiting periods for new turbines and electrical grid access stretch on for years. Due to these lengthy delays, builders are increasingly relying on once-discarded jet engines to supply power.

While this approach helps bypass grid connection bottlenecks, it presents notable drawbacks. According to reports, utilizing retired aviation engines for stationary power generation is both less efficient and less environmentally friendly compared to standard grid power or newer turbine technologies.

The shift highlights the growing infrastructure and energy challenges faced by the industry as the demand for digital and computing capacity continues to outpace traditional power supply timelines.
